requirements.text: The game window should be titled 'Apple Basket'.
requirements.check: The game window title displays 'Apple Basket'.
requirements.quote: Create a tiny one-screen catching game called "Apple Basket".

requirements.text: A woven basket sprite moves left and right at the bottom of the window.
requirements.check: Pressing LEFT arrow key moves the basket left; pressing RIGHT arrow key moves the basket right.
requirements.quote: A woven basket at the bottom of the window moves left and right with the arrow keys

requirements.text: The basket stops moving when it reaches the screen edges.
requirements.check: Holding LEFT arrow key when the basket is at the left edge does not move it further left. Holding RIGHT arrow key when the basket is at the right edge does not move it further right.
requirements.quote: and stops at the screen edges.

requirements.text: Red apples fall from random spots at the top of the screen at a steady speed.
requirements.check: Red circular apple objects appear at random x-coordinates at the top of the screen and move downwards at a constant rate.
requirements.quote: Red apples fall from random spots at the top at a steady speed

requirements.text: Catching an apple with the basket adds 1 point to the score.
requirements.check: When an apple collides with the basket, the score displayed in the top-left corner increases by 1.
requirements.quote: catching an apple with the basket adds 1 point.

requirements.text: If 3 apples reach the bottom of the screen without being caught, the game ends.
requirements.check: When the count of missed apples reaches 3, the game state changes to 'GAME OVER', and apples stop falling.
requirements.quote: If 3 apples reach the bottom without being caught, the game is over.

requirements.text: The score and missed apples count are shown in the top-left corner.
requirements.check: Text displaying 'Score: X' and 'Missed: Y' is visible in the top-left corner of the game window.
requirements.quote: Show the score and missed apples in the top-left corner.

requirements.text: When the game is over, 'GAME OVER' and the final score are displayed, and falling apples stop.
requirements.check: Upon game over, 'GAME OVER' text appears on screen, the final score is shown, and no new apples appear or move.
requirements.quote: When the game is over, show GAME OVER and the final score and stop the falling apples.

requirements.text: Pressing 'R' restarts the game with score 0.
requirements.check: Pressing 'R' key resets the score to 0, clears missed apples, and restarts apple falling.
requirements.quote: Press R to restart with score 0

requirements.check: Pressing 'Escape' key closes the game window.

requirements.text: Print 'MOVE LEFT' to the console when the left arrow key is pressed.
requirements.check: When the LEFT arrow key is pressed, 'MOVE LEFT' is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: Print a line to the console every time a control takes effect: MOVE LEFT

requirements.text: Print 'MOVE RIGHT' to the console when the right arrow key is pressed.
requirements.check: When the RIGHT arrow key is pressed, 'MOVE RIGHT' is printed to the console.

requirements.text: Print 'RESTART' to the console when the 'R' key is pressed.
requirements.check: When the 'R' key is pressed, 'RESTART' is printed to the console.

requirements.text: Print 'QUIT' to the console when the 'Escape' key is pressed.
requirements.check: When the 'Escape' key is pressed, 'QUIT' is printed to the console.

requirements.text: Print 'GAME OVER' to the console when the game ends.
requirements.check: When the game over condition is met, 'GAME OVER' is printed to the console.
requirements.quote: and print GAME OVER when the game ends.

files.purpose: Main game logic, initialization, and game loop.

assets.strategy_rationale: The spec explicitly requests two image assets: a woven basket and a sunny orchard background.

sprites.description: A rustic woven basket, brown and textured, suitable for catching apples.
A sunny orchard background with apple trees and blue sky, filling the entire game window.

architecture.test_input_example: Hold RIGHT for 100 frames, then LEFT for 50 frames. Wait for 3 apples to be missed. Press R. Press ESCAPE.

unmapped.handling: This is a negative constraint. The Coder should ensure no sound effects or background music are implemented.
